evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Skill-augmented agents load reusable skills as persistent runtime context, improving task performance but also giving malicious skills a durable channel for steering future actions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Further analyses demonstrate transfer across victim models, held-out risk families, and external benchmarks, as well as retained protection against adaptive attackers.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: To study this setting, we construct SCOPE-R, a task-conditioned dataset covering 6 risk families and 21 sub-categories, with 206 attack-confirmed malicious instances and 43 benign tasks.
